text: Able to understand and voluntarily sign a written informed consent form.
sub_conditions: Able to understand the informed consent form
Willing to voluntarily sign a written informed consent form

text: Male or female aged 18-74 years (inclusive).
Meet the diagnostic criteria for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).

Have initiated treatment with any one of the SGLT2i monotherapy (dapagliflozin 10mg/d, canagliflozin 100mg/d, empagliflozin 10mg/d, ertugliflozin 5mg/day, or henagliflozin 10mg/day) for at least 8 weeks.
sub_conditions: On SGLT2i monotherapy with one of: dapagliflozin 10 mg/d, canagliflozin 100 mg/d, empagliflozin 10 mg/d, ertugliflozin 5 mg/d, or henagliflozin 10 mg/d

text: Have received 500-1000mg/day metformin treatment for at least 8 weeks with a stable, unchanged dose maintained during the screening period.
sub_conditions: Stable unchanged dose during the screening period

text: HbA1c level within the range of 7.5% to 9.5% inclusive.
Fasting blood glucose (FBG) level less than 15 mmol/L before randomization.
Body mass index (BMI) less than or equal to 40 kg/m2 before randomization.
Urine ketone test negative before randomization.
Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of 60 ml/min/1.73m2 or higher before randomization.

Agree to maintain the same diet and exercise habits throughout the trial, and be willing and able to correctly use a home blood glucose meter for self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG) and keep records.
sub_conditions: Agree to maintain the same diet throughout the trial
Agree to maintain the same exercise habits throughout the trial
Willing and able to correctly use a home blood glucose meter for SMBG
Willing and able to keep records

text: Type 1 diabetes mellitus.
Various types of secondary diabetes.
Pending or having undergone pancreatic or β-cell transplantation.
History of pancreatitis or pancreatic resection.
Complicated with diabetic ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma.

Moderate or severe liver insufficiency of any cause, defined as ALT (SGPT), AST (SGOT), or alkaline phosphatase serum levels greater than 3 times the upper limit of normal (ULN) during the screening period.

Acute coronary syndrome (ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction, non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction, unstable angina), stroke, or transient ischemic attack (TIA) within the past 3 months.
Uncontrolled hypertension: systolic blood pressure ≥ 160 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure ≥ 90 mmHg.
Hemoglobin level less than 10 g/l or 100 mg/dl.
sub_conditions: Hemoglobin below threshold (10 g/dl as stated, units inconsistent)

text: Recurrent genitourinary infections more than twice within the past 3 months.
sub_conditions: More than 2 genitourinary infections within the past 3 months

text: History of bariatric surgery or other gastrointestinal surgeries causing chronic malabsorption within the past 2 years.
sub_conditions: Other GI surgery causing chronic malabsorption within past 2 years

text: Received anti-obesity medication within the past 3 months or any other treatment (e.g., surgery, radical diet plans) that led to unstable body weight at the time of screening.
sub_conditions: Other treatment (surgery, radical diet plans) causing unstable body weight at screening

text: History of cancer (except basal cell carcinoma) and/or cancer treatment within the past 5 years.
sub_conditions: Cancer other than basal cell carcinoma (history)

text: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) positivity.
Severe peripheral vascular disease.
Hematological malignancies or any diseases causing hemolysis or erythrocyte instability (e.g., malaria, babesiosis, hemolytic anemia).
sub_conditions: Disease causing hemolysis or erythrocyte instability (e.g., malaria, babesiosis, hemolytic anemia)

text: Coexisting immune system diseases or currently receiving systemic corticosteroid therapy.
Changes in thyroid hormone dosage within the past 6 weeks, or any other uncontrolled endocrine or metabolic disorders outside of T2DM.
sub_conditions: Thyroid hormone dose change within past 6 weeks
Other uncontrolled endocrine disorder outside T2DM
Other uncontrolled metabolic disorder outside T2DM

text: Alcohol or drug abuse within the past 3 months that may reduce trial compliance, or any chronic illnesses that the investigator believes may lead to reduced trial compliance or reduced use of the study drug.
sub_conditions: Alcohol abuse within past 3 months that may reduce compliance
Drug abuse within past 3 months that may reduce compliance
Chronic illness judged by investigator to reduce compliance or study drug use

text: Known allergies to components of the study medication or other drugs with similar chemical structures or excipients.
sub_conditions: Allergy to drugs with similar chemical structures

text: Pregnant women, women planning to become pregnant during the study, or lactating women.

Subjects unwilling to use reliable contraception (including condoms, spermicides, or intrauterine devices) from the time of signing the informed consent form until 28 days after the last administration of the study medication, or women planning to use progesterone-containing contraceptives during this period.
sub_conditions: Unwilling to use reliable contraception from consent until 28 days after last dose
Women planning to use progesterone-containing contraceptives during this period

text: Men with fertility plans during the study.
sub_conditions: Male with fertility plans during the study

text: Participation in any other clinical study within the past 30 days.
sub_conditions: Participated in another clinical study within past 30 days
needed_info: clinical trial participation history with dates

text: Any other condition deemed unsuitable for participation in this study by the investigator.
